integrity: Proof is a self-contained facet-removal, graph-cycle-filling and nerve argument; finite mod-two replay is corroborative, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two deleted vertices in binary hypercubes and ordinary open-neighborhood complexes; no equivariant or higher-puncture claim. Unindexed equivalent literature may exist.
title: Distance-three stabilization for open-neighborhood complexes of doubly punctured Boolean cubes
